top_signals.title: Angola Seeks to Keep Oil Output Above 1 Million Barrels a Day
top_signals.summary: Angola wants to keep crude production above 1 million barrels a day as Africa’s third-biggest oil producer tries to offset a decline in output from mature fields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
